feature_notes.age: Required by C_PM_KMY (entry age 18-40) and by most state asset schemes that specify an adult applicant. Sampled 18-75.
feature_notes.is_nt_c_dhangar: Nomadic Tribes-C (Dhangar and similar communities). MHSGC schemes are explicitly restricted to this category; this is NOT the same as SC/ST/OBC and is modelled as an overlay flag.
feature_notes.is_institution: True for goshala / gaushala / cooperative / FPO / SHG-federation applicants. Institutional labels (MH_GOSHALA, MH_GOVARDHAN_GOVANSH, C_DIDF, C_AHIDF, C_SDCFPO, C_NPDD) require this or a registered-entity route.
feature_notes.is_fpo_member: Gates C_FPO_10K equity/credit-guarantee benefits and C_ISAM_ENAM onboarding.
feature_notes.has_irrigation_source: Gates C_PDMC and MH_SHASHWAT_SINCHAN (micro-irrigation requires an assured water source).
feature_notes.grows_crops: Separates pure livestock keepers from crop farmers. Crop-side central schemes (NFSM, MIDH, PKVY, SHC, PMFBY) are gated on this.
feature_notes.is_incometax_payer: PM-KISAN and PM-KMY both operate 'subject to exclusions'; income-tax payers are the canonical exclusion. Treated as a hard exclusion - VERIFY current exclusion list.
feature_notes.in_pmddky_district: PM-DDKY covers 100 districts selected on low productivity / low cropping intensity / low credit. The specific Maharashtra district list was NOT retrieved - defaults to False for every row. Do not report PM-DDKY coverage numbers from this dataset until you load the official district list.

labels.name: 2 Milch Cow/Buffalo Unit - District Level (SC/TSP/OTSP)
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/district-level-schemes/ (retrieved). 2-milch unit: for SC, TSP and OTSP category, 75% subsidy; unit price Rs.70,000/cow, Rs.80,000/buffalo; 2-cow unit Rs.1,56,850; 2-buffalo unit Rs.1,79,258. Apply: ah.mahabms.com

labels.name: 2 Milch Cow/Buffalo Unit - State Level Innovative
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied): state-level innovative 2-milch scheme at 50% general / 75% SC-ST.

labels.name: Goat/Sheep Rearing Unit (10+1, semi-stall fed)
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in district-level schemes (retrieved). Goat/sheep: 10 + 1 buck/ram, SC/ST 75%; Osmanabadi/Sangamneri goat Rs.1,03,545, local goat Rs.78,231, Madgyal sheep Rs.1,28,850, Deccani/local sheep Rs.1,03,545.

labels.name: 100 Day-Old Chicks Distribution
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in district-level schemes (retrieved). 100 day-old chicks Rs.29,500, 50% subsidy for ALL categories.

labels.name: 25+3 Pullet Distribution
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in district-level schemes (retrieved). 25+3 pullets Rs.10,840, 50% subsidy for ALL categories.

labels.name: RajyaMata-GauMata Goshala Subsidy (Rs.50/day/cow)
labels.basis: Indian Express / Times of India / Tribune (retrieved): Maharashtra cabinet declared indigenous cows 'Rajyamata-Gaumata' and approved Rs.50 per day per desi cow to goshalas, on the stated ground that goshalas are not economically viable. GOSHALAS/COW-SHELTER OPERATORS ONLY - not individual owners. benefit_inr shown is Rs.50 x 365 for one cow.

labels.name: Sex-Sorted Semen AI Access
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied): sex-sorted semen access. Per-dose subsidised price was NOT verified from a GR.

labels.name: Animal Husbandry 'Agricultural' Status benefits
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied): July 2025 'agricultural status' for animal husbandry. Enabling policy, not a cash transfer - universal label.

labels.name: Revised Govardhan Govansh Seva Kendra Yojana
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/revised-govardhan-govansh-seva-kendra-yojana/ (retrieved). 100% State Scheme. Beneficiary: one eligible goshala per taluka, i.e. 324 goshalas in 324 talukas of 34 districts, per GR pavia-2021/p.no.356/padum-3 dated 17/05/2023. Benefit: subsidy of minimum Rs.15.00 lakh and maximum Rs.25.00 lakh depending on livestock numbers in the goshala. Apply in prescribed format to the district Deputy Commissioner of Animal Husbandry.

labels.name: Chief Minister Animal Health Scheme (Mobile Veterinary Units / 1962)
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/chief-minister-animal-health-scheme/ (retrieved). GR 25.02.2019: 349 mobile veterinary clinics announced, 80 approved in phase one, and equipped mobile veterinary teams operating in 73 talukas of 32 districts. Free doorstep service via toll-free 1962 and the Pashudhan Sanjivani app; 108 classified animal diseases triaged by severity. As on 31.07.2025, 16,61,184 livestock farmers had contacted the call centre and 8,74,593 animals received services. Universal for animal owners in covered talukas.

labels.name: Chief Minister Rural Livestock Entrepreneurship Scheme (State-Level)
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in (retrieved): homepage and document listing confirm a 'Chief Minister Rural Livestock Entrepreneurship Scheme' published as a State-Level Scheme by the Department of Animal Husbandry. SUBSIDY RATE, UNIT COST AND CATEGORY RULES WERE NOT RETRIEVED - label is included for coverage but eligibility logic here is a placeholder built on the generic state-scheme pattern (adult, rural, livestock-keeping). Pull the GR before using this label in training.

labels.name: Raje Yashwantrao Holkar Mahamesh Yojana (20 sheep + 1 ram)
labels.basis: mhsgc.org/en/schemes/ (retrieved), Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Maharashtra Sheep and Goat Development Corporation, Pune. Components: allotment of 20 sheep + 1 ram to NT-C beneficiaries at 75% subsidy; improved-breed ram at 75%; 75% for basic sheep-rearing facilities; 75% for balanced feed; 50% for Mini Silage Baler cum Wrapper; 50% for animal feed factories. Funds available Rs.29.50 crore; 2,240 beneficiaries allocated, selection completed via district selection committee. UNIT COST NOT STATED on the page, so benefit_inr is null.

labels.name: Grazing Subsidy for Sheep (NT-C shepherd families)
labels.basis: mhsgc.org/en/schemes/ (retrieved). Nomadic Tribes-C backward-class Dhangar and similar communities whose shepherd families hold at least 20 sheep and 1 ram: Rs.6,000 per month for four months (June to September), total Rs.24,000 one-time grazing subsidy. Funds Rs.5.00 crore, sanctioned provision 2024-25 Rs.3.33 crore, 3,470 beneficiaries allocated.

labels.name: Land Purchase/Lease Subsidy for Sheep & Goat Rearing
labels.basis: mhsgc.org/en/schemes/ (retrieved). State-level scheme for LANDLESS shepherd families of nomadic tribes (NT-C) Dhangar and similar communities: 75% of the price of 1 gunta of land for semi-closed/closed sheep rearing, or 75% of rent payable under a lease of minimum 30 years, as one-time lump-sum assistance of maximum Rs.50,000. Funds Rs.5.00 crore, 1,666 beneficiaries allocated.

labels.name: Goat/Sheep Semen Production Laboratory, Tirtha (Tuljapur, Dharashiv)
labels.basis: mhsgc.org/en/schemes/ (retrieved). Under the centrally sponsored National Livestock Mission, a divisional goat/sheep semen production laboratory at PU Prakshetra, Tirtha, Taluka Tuljapur, District Dharashiv. Total project Rs.716.65 lakh (central share Rs.430.00 lakh, state share Rs.286.65 lakh); Rs.240.00 lakh for building and animal sheds, Rs.476.65 lakh for equipment, chemicals, buck purchase and skilled manpower. INFRASTRUCTURE - no individual beneficiary; label is informational only.

labels.name: Scale-up of Artificial Insemination in Goats and Sheep
labels.basis: mhsgc.org/en/schemes/ (retrieved). Under National Livestock Mission: purchase and supply of goat AI materials to veterinary clinics to scale AI in goats and sheep from existing cow-buffalo AI centres; being supplied to 1,666 veterinary clinics under the Animal Husbandry Department. Sanctioned provision 2024-25 Rs.1.16 crore.

labels.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
labels.basis: The Hindu (retrieved): 91.65 lakh Maharashtra farmers received Rs.1892.61 crore under Namo Shetkari Yojana; farmers receive an additional benefit of Rs.6,000 per year from the State alongside the central transfer. Vikaspedia (retrieved): yearly grant of Rs.6,000 to farmers. Effectively a state top-up on PM-KISAN, so it is gated on the same landholding-farmer basis.

labels.name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Suraksha Sanugrah Anudan Yojana
labels.basis: myscheme.gov.in and krishi.maharashtra.gov.in GR listing (retrieved): scheme covers farmers against accidents, applicable 24 hours a day for the prescribed period. Times of India on the 2023 state budget (retrieved): under the revised scheme the family of an accident-affected farmer is given a grant of up to Rs.2 lakh. Applies to accidental death or disability of a farmer in the family.

labels.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
labels.basis: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in farmer scheme listing (retrieved) confirms this as an Agriculture Department scheme alongside Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana. Lokmat Times (retrieved): Rs.15 crore sanctioned, 600 beneficiaries, selection through the MahaDBT portal. Targeted at SC / Navbouddha farmers for well, borewell, pump-set and irrigation assets. COMPONENT-WISE CEILINGS WERE NOT RETRIEVED - verify on MahaDBT before quoting amounts.

labels.name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (TSP / OTSP)
labels.basis: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in farmer scheme listing (retrieved): 'Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana (Tribal Sub Plan / Outside Tribal Sub Plan)'. zppalghar.gov.in (retrieved) describes stacked irrigation assistance with a 15% Birsa Munda component alongside Mukhyamantri Shashwat Irrigation Yojana shares. Targeted at ST farmers. EXACT CEILINGS NOT RETRIEVED.

labels.name: Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump Yojana (solar agriculture pump)
labels.basis: portal.mahadiscom.in/solar_MTSKPY/ and its FAQ (retrieved), run by Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. (toll free 1800-212-3435 / 1800-233-3435). To participate, general-category beneficiaries pay 10 percent of the solar agriculture pump price; the balance is met by government share. Requires an assured irrigation water source. SC/ST beneficiary contribution percentage was not retrieved from the FAQ text.

labels.name: Mukhyamantri Shashwat Krishi Sinchan Yojana
labels.basis: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in (retrieved) lists 'Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme' among farmer schemes; zppalghar.gov.in (retrieved) references a Mukhyamantri Shashwat Irrigation Yojana 30% / 10% share layered on top of central micro-irrigation assistance. Operates as a state top-up over PDMC. TOP-UP PERCENTAGES BY CATEGORY NOT FULLY VERIFIED.

labels.name: State Agriculture Mechanization Scheme
labels.basis: mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/SchemeData (retrieved): State Agriculture Mechanization Scheme. Stated conditions: farmer must have Aadhaar card, 7/12 certificate and 8-A certificate; if the farmer belongs to SC or ST category a caste certificate is required. IMPLICATION MODELLED: landless applicants are ineligible because 7/12 and 8-A are land records. MACHINERY-WISE SUBSIDY RATES NOT RETRIEVED.

labels.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojana (loan waiver)
labels.basis: Maharashtra budget speech document hosted on cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in (retrieved) lists 'Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojana' alongside Gopinath Munde Shetkari Suraksha Sanugrah Anudan Yojana and Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani. CUT-OFF DATES, OUTSTANDING-LOAN CEILING AND CURRENT OPEN/CLOSED STATUS WERE NOT RETRIEVED. Requires an existing crop loan; do not treat as an open-ended entitlement.

labels.name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp (PoCRA)
labels.basis: Maharashtra budget speech document (retrieved) names Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani as a state agriculture programme. It is a climate-resilient agriculture project operating in SELECTED PROJECT VILLAGES only, which is why eligibility here is gated on a village-inclusion flag that this dataset does not have; modelled as a rainfed/drought-district proxy and flagged for verification.

labels.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes-programmes (retrieved) lists RASHTRIYA GOKUL MISSION (RGM) as a current DAHD scheme; dahd.maharashtra.gov.in also lists Rashtriy Gokul Mission (RGM) as implemented in the state. Focus is indigenous bovine breed development and conservation, so gated on indigenous/RGM-recognised bovine breeds.

labels.name: NLM - Sub-Mission on Livestock Entrepreneurship
labels.basis: nlm.udyamimitra.in + PIB (retrieved): NLM entrepreneurship sub-mission gives 50% capital subsidy up to Rs.50 lakh for poultry / sheep / goat / pig (also horse, camel, donkey) breeding farms.

labels.name: NLM - Sub-Mission on Breed Development of Livestock and Poultry
labels.basis: nlm.udyamimitra.in/Home/SubmissionOnBreed (retrieved): 'One Time 50% capital subsidy of the total project cost will be provided with maximum subsidy up to Rs. 25 lakh for each unit.' NOTE: this Rs.25 lakh cap is a DIFFERENT sub-mission from the Rs.50 lakh entrepreneurship cap in C_NLM_SLED. The two are deliberately kept as separate labels.

labels.name: NLM - Feed and Fodder Development
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/national-livestock-mission/ (retrieved): 'The focus of the scheme is on entrepreneurship development and breed improvement in poultry, sheep, goat and piggery, including feed and fodder development.' mhsgc.org (retrieved) separately shows a 50% subsidy for Mini Silage Baler cum Wrapper and 50% for animal feed factories under Mahamesh. SUBSIDY CEILING FOR THE FODDER COMPONENT NOT RETRIEVED.

labels.name: Kisan Credit Card - Animal Husbandry (PKCC)
labels.basis: PIB press release (retrieved): collateral-free KCC limit raised from Rs.1.6 lakh to Rs.2 lakh per borrower w.e.f. 01-Jan-2025. DAHD AHDF-KCC guidelines (retrieved): overall limit Rs.3 lakh per annum. dahd.maharashtra.gov.in also lists Kisan Credit Cards (KCC) as a state-implemented scheme. NOTE: this SUPERSEDES the Rs.1.6 lakh figure in the uploaded doc.

labels.name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (NABARD)
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied) central scheme table. DEDS DOES NOT APPEAR on the current dahd.gov.in/en/schemes-programmes list retrieved in this session, which shows RGM, NLM, LHDCP, NPDD, LC&ISS, AHIDF, SDCFPO and NGRA. Treat DEDS as POSSIBLY CLOSED OR SUBSUMED and confirm with NABARD before surfacing it to a user.

labels.name: Livestock Insurance Scheme (under NLM)
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied) central scheme table lists Livestock Insurance under NLM. Premium-share percentages and the per-animal sum-insured ceiling were NOT verified against a DAHD document in this session.

labels.name: National Animal Disease Control Programme
labels.basis: dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/national-animal-disease-control-programme-nadcp/ (retrieved, listed as state-implemented). PIB (retrieved): the scheme also supports door-step delivery of livestock health care through the Mobile Veterinary Units (ESVHD-MVU) sub-component. Free FMD and brucellosis vaccination - applies to bovines, and to small ruminants/pigs for FMD.

labels.name: Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes-programmes/lhdcp (retrieved): focuses on disease prevention, control and management along with strengthening veterinary infrastructure and services. dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/livestock-health-disease-control-lhdc/ (retrieved): administrative approval given for establishment of mobile veterinary units in the state under the scheme. Universal service label for any animal owner.

labels.name: National Programme for Dairy Development
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes/programmes/npdd (retrieved) and PIB (retrieved): NPDD was restructured/realigned in July 2021 for implementation from 2021-22 to 2025-26 with two components; Component B covers 9 states. nddb.coop (retrieved) confirms it is a central sector scheme with eligibility centred on State Cooperative Dairy Federations/Unions, State Rural Livelihood Mission for SHG projects, and milk unions - i.e. INSTITUTIONAL, not individual.

labels.name: Dairy Processing & Infrastructure Development Fund
labels.basis: Livestock_Government_Schemes_Maharashtra.docx (user-supplied) central scheme table. Like DEDS, DIDF does not appear on the dahd.gov.in scheme list retrieved in this session. Institutional (milk unions / cooperatives / producer companies) - individual farmers are not direct applicants.

labels.name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes/programmes/ahidf (retrieved) and dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/animal-husbandry-infrastructure-development-fund-ahidf/ (retrieved). Credit-linked interest-subvention facility for dairy/meat processing, feed plants and breed multiplication; eligible entities include individual entrepreneurs, FPOs, MSMEs, private companies and Section 8 companies. Requires a bankable project, so gated on an entrepreneurial route rather than plain animal ownership.

labels.name: Supporting Dairy Cooperatives and Farmer Producer Organizations
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes/programmes/sdcfpo (retrieved) lists SUPPORTING DAIRY COOPERATIVES & FARMER PRODUCER ORGANIZATIONS (SDCFPO) as a current DAHD scheme. Beneficiary route is the cooperative or FPO, so gated on is_institution or is_fpo_member.

labels.name: National Gopal Ratna Award
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes/programmes/ngra (retrieved) lists NATIONAL GOPAL RATNA AWARD (NGRA). Competitive award for best dairy farmers rearing indigenous breeds, best AI technicians and best dairy cooperatives - NOT an entitlement. Modelled as eligible-to-apply for indigenous-breed keepers; prize amounts were not retrieved.

labels.name: Livestock Census and Integrated Sample Survey
labels.basis: dahd.gov.in/en/schemes/programmes/animal-husbandry-statistics (retrieved) and dahd.maharashtra.gov.in/en/scheme/livestock-census-and-integrated-sample-survey/ (retrieved). This is a STATISTICAL OPERATION, not a benefit. Included only so the manifest mirrors the official scheme list; it confers no transfer and should be excluded from any recommendation ranking.

labels.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): central sector scheme launched 24 February 2019 to supplement financial needs of LAND HOLDING farmers, subject to exclusions. Rs.6,000 per year in three equal four-monthly instalments by DBT; Rs.2.81 lakh crore transferred to more than 11 crore beneficiaries at the time of the reply.

labels.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan MaanDhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): contributory central sector scheme launched 12 September 2019 for small and marginal farmers subject to exclusions; applicants aged 18 to 40 contribute Rs.55 to Rs.200 per month until age 60 with matching central contribution, then receive Rs.3,000 monthly pension. LIC is the pension fund manager. nfwpis.da.gov.in (retrieved): entry age 18 to 40, cultivable land up to 2 hectares per state land records. benefit_inr is the annualised pension (Rs.3,000 x 12).

labels.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): launched 2016, comprehensive risk cover for crops against all non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest; demand driven and available for ALL farmers; 5,549.40 lakh farmer applications insured since 2016-17 with Rs.1,50,589.10 crore paid as claims. MAHARASHTRA-SPECIFIC NOTE: Indian Express and Times of India (retrieved) report the state SCRAPPED its Re-1 crop insurance variant after fake applications were found, reverting to standard PMFBY with farmers paying roughly 2 percent premium for kharif. Requires a sown crop, so gated on grows_crops.

labels.name: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (short-term agri credit)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): concessional short-term agri loans for crop husbandry AND allied activities including animal husbandry, dairying and fisheries; available on short-term loans up to Rs.3.00 lakh at 7% per annum, with an additional 3% for prompt repayment reducing the effective rate to 4%. Post-harvest loans against Negotiable Warehouse Receipts also covered for small and marginal farmers holding KCCs. Requires a KCC or short-term loan.

labels.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): medium-to-long-term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets, with 3% per annum interest subvention and CGTMSE credit guarantee for loans up to Rs.2 crore; Rs.1 lakh crore disbursed FY2020-21 to FY2025-26 with support until FY2032-33. Eligible beneficiaries explicitly include farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, start-ups, PACS, marketing cooperatives, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, APMCs, state agencies and federations. Each entity may benefit for up to 25 projects in different LGD codes.

labels.name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): central sector scheme launched 2020, outlay Rs.6,865 crore. Financial assistance up to Rs.18.00 lakh per FPO over 3 years; matching equity grant up to Rs.2,000 per farmer member capped at Rs.15.00 lakh per FPO; credit guarantee up to Rs.2 crore of project loan per FPO. FPOs are onboarded on e-NAM. 7,774 FPOs registered as on 31.12.2023. Benefit flows to the FPO, so gated on is_fpo_member or is_institution.

labels.name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): central sector scheme launched 2020 under Atma Nirbhar Bharat for scientific beekeeping; honeybees approved as the 5th input for agriculture; 4 world-class and 35 mini honey testing labs sanctioned; Madhukranti portal for registration; 23 lakh bee colonies registered; 160 projects sanctioned worth Rs.202.00 crore across 25 States/UTs. NOT A CATTLE OR CROP SCHEME - this dataset has no beekeeping feature, so eligibility is left at 0 for every row rather than guessed. Label exists for coverage completeness only.

labels.name: Market Intervention Scheme and Price Support Scheme
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): PSS for procurement of pulses, oilseeds and copra; MIS for perishable agricultural and horticultural commodities not covered under PSS. Objective is to protect growers from distress sale when prices fall below economic levels during peak arrival. Gated on grows_crops.

labels.name: Namo Drone Didi
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): central sector scheme for 2024-25 to 2025-26 with outlay Rs.1,261 crore, providing drones to 15,000 selected Women Self Help Groups for rental services to farmers. Central financial assistance at 80% of drone and accessory cost up to a maximum of Rs.8.0 lakh; SHG Cluster Level Federations may raise the balance as an AIF loan with 3% interest subvention; expected additional SHG income at least Rs.1.0 lakh per annum. WOMEN SHG MEMBERS ONLY.

labels.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (DPR-based)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): centrally sponsored scheme for pre- and post-harvest infrastructure in agriculture and allied sectors, giving states flexibility to implement projects per local farmer needs. Under the RKVY Agri-startup Programme 1,524 start-ups were selected since 2019-20 with Rs.106.25 crore released as grants-in-aid. mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in (retrieved) lists 'Rashtriya Krushi Vikas Yojana - RAFTAAR' as a state-delivered farmer scheme. State/project route, not a direct individual entitlement.

labels.name: Soil Health Card
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): provides farmers information on the nutrient status of their soil with recommended nutrient dosage; decentralised soil testing feeding a nationwide GIS soil fertility map; 5 crore soil samples planned across 2023-24 to 2025-26. Free advisory service for landholding crop farmers.

labels.name: Rainfed Area Development
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): implemented since 2014-15, area-based cluster approach promoting Integrated Farming System with multi-cropping, rotational, inter- and mixed cropping plus allied activities including HORTICULTURE, LIVESTOCK, FISHERY and APICULTURE, to sustain livelihoods and mitigate drought and flood. Rs.1,673.58 crore released covering 7.13 lakh hectares. Relevant to livestock keepers on rainfed land - one of the few crop-side schemes that explicitly includes livestock.

labels.name: Per Drop More Crop (micro-irrigation)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): launched 2015-16 for water use efficiency through drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation, 78 lakh hectares covered 2015-16 to 2022-23; Micro Irrigation Fund now merged into PDMC. mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in PDMC page (retrieved) gives the Maharashtra subsidy split: SMALL AND MARGINAL FARMERS 55%, OTHER FARMERS 45%. Requires land and an assured water source.

labels.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (organic farming)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): cluster mode with unit cluster size 20 hectares and minimum 20 farmers per group; a farmer may avail benefit for a maximum of 2 ha; 25 clusters aggregate into a ~500 ha cluster for marketing. Assistance Rs.31,500 per hectare to states, of which Rs.15,000 goes to the farmer directly through DBT. benefit_inr is the direct DBT share.

labels.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): implemented from April 2014 to extend farm mechanization to SMALL AND MARGINAL FARMERS and low farm-power regions, promote Custom Hiring Centres, and create hi-tech hubs. Rs.6,748.78 crore released; over 15,75,719 machines distributed; 23,472 Custom Hiring Centres, 504 Hi-Tech Hubs and 20,597 Farm Machinery Banks established. Also carries Kisan drone promotion: Rs.138.82 crore released, 317 drones for demonstration over 79,070 hectares, 461 drones supplied to farmers on subsidy and 1,595 to CHCs for rental.

labels.name: Crop Residue Management
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): implemented from 2018-19 in PUNJAB, HARYANA, UTTAR PRADESH AND NCT OF DELHI ONLY, for in-situ crop residue management and Farm Machinery Banks. Rs.3,333.17 crore released, over 2,95,845 CRM machines distributed; CRM is now merged with SMAM. NOT APPLICABLE TO MAHARASHTRA - eligibility is hard-coded to 0 for every row in this dataset.

labels.name: Agroforestry (under RKVY)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): conceived on the recommendation of the National Agroforestry Policy 2014 to promote plantation on farmlands; restructured under RKVY to provide Quality Planting Materials and certification for planting trees on farmland to improve farmer livelihoods. Requires own land.

labels.name: National Food Security Mission
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): increases production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals (maize and barley) and nutri-cereals in identified districts of 28 states and 2 UTs. 25 seed hubs established; millet missions launched across 13 states INCLUDING MAHARASHTRA. Sub-Mission on Seed and Planting Material (SMSP) is now merged with NFSM. Gated on grows_crops.

labels.name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): centrally sponsored scheme launched 2021 to promote oil palm cultivation, bringing an additional 6.5 lakh ha under oil palm with 3.28 lakh ha in north-eastern states and 3.22 lakh ha in the rest of India from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Agro-climatically marginal for most of Maharashtra; eligibility left at 0 because this dataset has no oil-palm suitability feature.

labels.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): centrally sponsored scheme launched 2014-15 for fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, coconut, cashew, cocoa and bamboo. Components include new orchards, rejuvenation of old and senile orchards, protected cultivation, organic farming, POLLINATION SUPPORT THROUGH BEEKEEPING, horticulture mechanization and post-harvest management. National Bamboo Mission is now merged with MIDH. Gated on grows_crops with own land.

labels.name: National Bamboo Mission
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): implemented in 23 states and 1 UT through State Bamboo Missions; 367 bamboo nurseries established, 46,000 ha of bamboo plantations on non-forest government and private land, 81 primary processing units, 416 value-addition units, capacity building for 15,000 farmers, artisans and entrepreneurs. NBM is now merged with MIDH. Requires own non-forest land.

labels.name: Integrated Scheme for Agriculture Marketing / e-NAM
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): ISAM supports state governments in agricultural produce marketing through market structures, capacity building and market information; e-NAM became part of it in 2017-18. 1,389 mandis across 23 states and 4 UTs integrated; more than 1.76 crore farmers and 2.5 lakh traders registered. Free registration service for anyone marketing produce.

labels.name: Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA)
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): makes the extension system farmer-driven and farmer-accountable through the Agricultural Technology Management Agency (ATMA) at district level. Digital initiatives include VISTAAR, Apurva AI, Krishi 24X7, Kisan Call Centre integration, IMD weather advisory via DAMU, and NRLM decentralised extension cadres explicitly including KRISHI SAKHI, PASHU SAKHI and MATSYA SAKHI. Universal advisory service - the Pashu Sakhi cadre makes it directly relevant to livestock keepers.

labels.name: Digital Agriculture / AgriStack
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): improves the National e-Governance Plan in Agriculture by building open-source, open-standard, interoperable digital public infrastructure. AgriStack foundational layers include core registries, base databases, a Farmers Database with farmer ID linked to land records, geo-referencing of plots, crop survey and planning, soil mapping and fertility, a Unified Farmers Service Interface and data exchange. Enabling infrastructure - universal, no cash transfer.

labels.name: Prime Minister Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
labels.basis: pmindia.gov.in and PIB release 2145146 (retrieved): Cabinet approved the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana on 16 July 2025 for six years beginning 2025-26, pursuant to the 2025-26 Budget announcement, covering 100 districts identified on three key indicators - low productivity, low cropping intensity and low credit availability. pmddky.niti.gov.in confirms the same approval date and duration. THE 100-DISTRICT LIST WAS NOT RETRIEVED, so in_pmddky_district defaults to False for all rows and this label is 0 everywhere until you load the official list.

labels.name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region
labels.basis: PIB release 2002012 (retrieved): develops commodity-specific certified organic production clusters in value-chain mode in Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura. Rs.1,035.17 crore released, 379 FPO/FPCs covering 1,89,039 farmers and 1,72,966 ha. NORTH EAST ONLY - NOT APPLICABLE TO MAHARASHTRA. Eligibility hard-coded to 0; retained so the manifest is a faithful mirror of the DA&FW scheme list.

assumptions: Social-category, land-holding, gender and employment marginals are plausible priors for a rural applicant pool, not verified Maharashtra statistics. Edit PRIORS before quoting any distributional claim.

Asset-transfer schemes (2-milch unit, goat/sheep unit, chicks, pullets, Mahamesh) are treated as ACQUISITION schemes: an applicant who already owns many animals of that species is down-ranked, and above OWN_CAP is treated as not a target beneficiary. The GRs do not state such a cap.

OBC is treated as eligible for the state-level (general) 2-milch scheme at 50%, and as a 'backward class' for the poultry schemes, but NOT for the district-level SC/TSP/OTSP 2-milch and goat/sheep components. Verify against the current GR / district office.
Breed is sampled independently of district by default. Breed-tract geography (e.g. which division a breed is concentrated in) was NOT verified here, so USE_REGION_TILT defaults to False.

NEW: is_nt_c_dhangar is sampled as an independent overlay flag at 6% of rows. The true NT-C / Dhangar share of Maharashtra's rural population was NOT verified. Every MHSGC label (Mahamesh, grazing subsidy, land subsidy) depends on this flag, so its prior directly drives those three prevalence rates - treat them as illustrative only.

NEW: institutional labels (MH_GOSHALA, MH_GOVARDHAN_GOVANSH, C_NPDD, C_DIDF, C_SDCFPO, C_FPO_10K) are gated on is_institution / is_fpo_member, which are synthetic flags. A row representing an individual farmer will correctly show 0 for these. This is a deliberate change from v1, where MH_GOSHALA was emitted for individuals.

NEW: MH_GOVARDHAN_GOVANSH is capped at ONE goshala per taluka (324 statewide). This dataset has no taluka column, so the label indicates 'eligible to apply', not 'will receive'. Do not read selection probability off this column.

NEW: C_CRM and C_MOVCDNER are geographically inapplicable to Maharashtra and are hard-zeroed. C_NBHM, C_NMEO_OP and C_PMDDKY are zeroed for want of a required feature (beekeeping, oil-palm suitability, PM-DDKY district list). They are present as columns so that downstream code sees the full official scheme space.

NEW: labels carrying verify=true have a NAME confirmed from an official or reputable source but SUBSIDY RATES / CEILINGS / CURRENT STATUS not retrieved. Their eligibility rules are pattern-based placeholders. Do not train a production recommender on those columns without pulling the underlying GR.

NEW: max_benefit_inr and the top1/top3 ranking WILL DIFFER from v1 for most rows, because the eligible set is larger and because ranking now uses the explicit 'priority' field in this manifest rather than v1's implicit order. Retrain rather than comparing metrics across versions.

NEW: several labels are services, policies, awards or statistical operations with no cash value (benefit_inr null). They inflate n_eligible without adding money. Use the 'kind' field to filter if you need a transfer-only count.
caveat: Rupee figures for the district-level animal husbandry components come from GRs of 2021-2023 as republished by the Maharashtra Animal Husbandry Department. Central agriculture figures come from PIB release 2002012 dated 02 FEB 2024 and may have been revised in later budgets. Maharashtra's Re-1 crop insurance variant has been SCRAPPED per retrieved press reporting - quote standard PMFBY premiums instead. MahaDBT displays a banner that the farmer portal is pending reopening, so application windows may be closed. Confirm everything on ah.mahabms.com, mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in, mhsgc.org or with the district Animal Husbandry / Agriculture office before any real application.
